{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America supports HR 900 to cancel $85 billion in sequestration cuts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sequestration cuts will harm millions of low-income Americans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sequestration cuts will weaken an already anemic, jobless recovery.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If the sequestration cuts are fully carried out, GDP will drop by 0.6%.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If the sequestration cuts are fully carried out, over 700,000 jobs will be lost.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Layoffs of 700,000 public employees since 2008 have contributed to unconscionable levels of unemployment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The country does not have a deficit crisis; it has a jobs crisis.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Sequestering will increase the deficit by slowing the economic recovery.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Sequestering will increase the deficit by keeping more people out of work and not paying taxes.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A 21st-century full employment program is needed to make public investments that help the long-term unemployed and returning veterans find decent jobs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Decent jobs contribute to the economy and to society.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The sequester adds to the jobs crisis by reducing extended unemployment benefits.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The sequester adds to the jobs crisis by slashing job training programs for returning veterans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
